title: Harvest festivals greeting: Lohri, Makar Sankranti, Uttarayan, Pongal
hook: Lohri, Makar Sankranti, Uttarayan and Pongal: four names for one shared idea, giving thanks for the harvest as the days grow longer.
caption:
Lohri, Makar Sankranti, Uttarayan and Pongal: four names for one shared idea, giving thanks for the harvest as the days grow longer.

However you are celebrating this week, with a bonfire, a kite, til-gud or a pot of pongal, warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.

May what you planted last year come good in this one.
alt_text: Festive greeting on a violet background with a kite: Happy Sankranti. May what you planted last year come good in this one. Warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.
